notes: Marasa Africa's Kenya portfolio (this folder) covers 3 properties sharing one contract family: Aberdare Country Club, The Ark, Mara Leisure Camp. Marasa Africa also operates Uganda properties (Marasa Chobe, Marasa Paraa, Marasa Mweya, Silverback Lodge) whose rates appear in '2025 Marasa Africa East Africa Net Contracted Rates.pdf' and are OUT OF SCOPE for this Kenya extraction - not extracted here.
'Marasa Contract - Sunworld Safaris.pdf' in this folder is a scanned/image-only document with no extractable text - skipped.

Two 2026-dated rate cards are the primary, verified source: '00 Published Rack Rates' (public rate) and '02 Local and Regional STO Nett Rates' (Sunworld's discounted rate), both explicitly valid 1 Jul-31 Dec 2026 only - no 2026 H1 (Jan-Jun) card was found in this folder.

The 2025-dated DMC Wholesale and Resident-rate documents are INCLUDED below purely as historical/structural reference (season definitions, game package descriptions) - their pricing is NOT current for 2026 and should not be quoted without a fresh 2026 equivalent.
STO discount confirmed arithmetically: STO = Rack x 0.75 exactly (e.g. Classic Double Low season: $171 STO vs $228 Rack = 0.75). This is an STO 25% tier.
'CHILD UNDER 3' column reads 0 throughout - i.e. free of charge for children under 3, consistent across all Marasa Kenya properties.
43 Classic Rooms, 1 Signature Room, 2 Superior Cottages, 1 Signature Cottage.
